title: Amethyst Clicker
description: AmethystClicker is a community-focused Paper plugin where players click amethyst blocks to earn rewards and unlock global community bonuses. Simple, fun, and fully configurable.
body:
AmethystClicker is a lightweight yet powerful Paper plugin designed to turn amethyst blocks into an interactive community feature.

Players can click (hit) amethyst blocks in a configured world to earn money rewards, with a small chance to receive gems via CoinsEngine. The system is optimized for fairness with built-in anti-autoclick protection, gamemode checks, and configurable limits.

Every valid click contributes one point to a global community progress bar. Once the configured goal is reached, the plugin triggers a community reward, executing configurable commands (such as crate rewards) and broadcasting a server-wide message. Community rewards can be weighted by percentage, allowing rare, epic, or jackpot-style outcomes.

The plugin integrates seamlessly with Vault (EssentialsX Economy), CoinsEngine, PlaceholderAPI, and TAB, making it easy to display progress and stats on scoreboards, sidebars, and GUIs.

Key Features

Click-based amethyst interaction (no block breaking required)

Works on any Amethyst Block in the configured world

Money rewards via Vault

Optional gem rewards via CoinsEngine

Click-based community progress system

Weighted community rewards with configurable chances

Anti-autoclick protection

Fully configurable messages, sounds, and limits

Persistent data storage

Available Placeholders

%amethyst_player_mined% – Player total clicks

%amethyst_total_mined% – Total clicks by all players

%amethyst_progress_to_reward% – Current community progress

%amethyst_missing_to_reward% – Remaining clicks until reward

%amethyst_reward_amount% – Community goal amount

%amethyst_last_reward_time% – Time since last community reward

AmethystClicker is perfect for servers looking to encourage cooperation, reward activity, and add a polished, engaging mechanic to their spawn or hub world.
